resources.string: The portal URL can\'t be used. Check the address, and allow insecure HTTP if it starts with http://.
Nothing at this address answered like a portal. Check the address and the network.

The portal refused this device. Check that the MAC address is registered with your provider, and that the serial number (and device IDs, if your provider uses them) match your registered box. The portal\'s message may name the wrong field.
The portal rejected the session. The device settings may not match what it expects.
The portal sent a reply this app doesn\'t understand yet.
The portal\'s address can\'t be resolved. Check the network connection.
The portal didn\'t answer in time.
A secure connection to the portal couldn\'t be established.
